compiled_state.title: Write RED tests: classifier reads review.size_upgrade_lines and review.size_warn_lines from config
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_upgrade_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 300 when absent; verified by a test that sets the key and confirms the threshold changes.
- DD2: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_warn_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 600 when absent; verified by a test.

## TDD Requirement (RED phase)
Modify tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh to add:

1. test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_config_override
   Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a temp config containing "review.size_upgrade_lines=200"
   When: classifier runs on a 200-line non-test source diff
   Then: size_action == "upgrade" (not "none" — threshold honored from config, not hardcoded 300)

2. test_classifier_size_warn_lines_config_override
   Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a temp config containing "review.size_warn_lines=400"
   When: classifier runs on a 400-line non-test source diff
   Then: size_action == "warn" (not "upgrade" — threshold honored from config, not hardcoded 600)

3. test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_default_fallback
   Given: no config file present (WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE points to a nonexistent file)
   When: classifier runs on a 300-line non-test source diff
   Then: size_action == "upgrade" (default 300 honored when config absent)

4. test_classifier_size_warn_lines_default_fallback
   Given: no config file present
   When: classifier runs on a 600-line diff
   Then: size_action == "warn" (default 600 honored when config absent)

All four tests must FAIL before Task T2 is implemented (classifier still uses hardcoded 300/600).
Add RED markers in .test-index for all four test function names.

Pattern Reference (from existing config override test pattern in same test file, lines 98-118):
  # from tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
  run_classifier() {
      CLASSIFIER_OUTPUT=$(REPO_ROOT="$REPO_ROOT" _MERGE_STATE_GIT_DIR="${TEST_GIT_DIR:-}" bash "$CLASSIFIER" < "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null)
  }
  # Use WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE env var for test isolation (read-config.sh seam):
  WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TEST_TMPDIR/test-config.conf"
  printf 'review.behavioral_patterns=skills/**\n' > "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE"
  output=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE" ... bash "$CLASSIFIER" ...)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — existing tests must not break
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL|Summary)"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_config_override function exists in tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
  Verify: grep -q "test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_config_override" tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] test_classifier_size_warn_lines_config_override function exists in tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
  Verify: grep -q "test_classifier_size_warn_lines_config_override" tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_default_fallback function exists
  Verify: grep -q "test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_default_fallback" tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] test_classifier_size_warn_lines_default_fallback function exists
  Verify: grep -q "test_classifier_size_warn_lines_default_fallback" tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for all 4 new test functions for plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh
  Verify: grep "review-complexity-classifier" .test-index | grep -q "test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_config_override"
- [ ] All 4 new tests FAIL before T2 implementation (RED — thresholds still hardcoded)
  Verify: Run the 4 new test functions directly and confirm they exit non-zero

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
